messages:
Alex (Sales): Handing off new pilot with VeloTech. Asks: Okta SSO, private-eval for HIPAA subset, embeddings pipeline for internal search, 3-week pilot. Customer PM: tina@velotech.com, eng: marco@velotech.com. Pilot target start 2026-06-01.
Priya (CS): Ill take kickoff and enablement. Rae will run success metrics and feedback capture. Need Okta metadata + sample docs (50-200).
Diego (Solutions Eng): Recommend hosted start then private-eval for PII. infra notes: allowlist a couple CIDRs, OIDC callback, short ingest script. Please provide sample docs and expected QPS.
Maya (Support): Created ticket SUP-7022 for SSO/network. Waiting on Okta XML + tenant ID. Tagging renewal-watch: pilot-cost-sensitivity.
Rae (CS Ops): Onboarding plan: week0 kickoff/access, week1 ingest+eval, week2 QA metrics, week3 retro/billing. Metrics: relevance NDCG proxy, avg tokens, error rate. Ill draft a one-page feedback form and post it here before kickoff.
Alex (Sales): Tina confirmed 6/1 window. Ill send invite for 2026-06-02 09:00 PT to allow for procurement.
Priya (CS): Owners recap and next steps:
- Priya: kickoff & enablement
- Rae: metrics, feedback form
- Diego: private-eval setup
- Maya: SUP-7022 SSO/network
- Alex: customer contact + docs
Diego: Ill estimate pilot cost after sample docs arrive  aim for 2026-05-30 EOD.
calendar-bot: Event created: VeloTech Pilot Kickoff  2026-06-02T16:00:00Z (organizer: Priya)
